principle_violations.reason: The Order class has multiple responsibilities: storing item data and managing order status.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the responsibilities by creating a class to handle item storage (e.g., OrderItemsManager) and provide methods in Order class to interact with it.

principle_violations.reason: The code for changing the order status to 'paid' is repeated in both PaypalPaymentProcessor and CreditCardPaymentProcessor.
principle_violations.suggestion: Refactor the order status change logic into a separate method that can be reused across different processors.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
